correctness.rationale: The uniform stationary measure follows from the row/column-zero generator. For n=3,4,5 every binary coloring (after possible label complementation) has at most two marked sites and hence a coloring-preserving reflection; conjugacy to the stationary reversed generator proves full path-law reversibility. For n=6, f=(1,1,0,1,0,0), the exact semigroup expansion gives Delta(epsilon)=((a-b)(a^2+ab+b^2)/6)epsilon^3+O(epsilon^4), nonzero for every a!=b at small positive epsilon. Two-frame and three-equal-frame impossibility uses stationary binary marginal identities. The standalone checker passed 458 assertions, including symbolic identity, complete finite small-ring enumeration and independent numerical semigroups.

originality.rationale: The inspected primary literature establishes broader partial-observation thermodynamic tools but not the precise minimal binary-coloring ring obstruction and explicit unequal-gap triple-time witness. Direct implication comparisons distinguish resolved directed transitions, resolved-state finite-lag asymmetry and milestoning from the raw binary observation used here. Remaining general HMM/dihedral theorems are a genuine risk.
residual_risks: General hidden-Markov path-symmetry or observational-equivalence literature may derive this as a corollary without using the same terminology.
Binary bracelet enumeration is classical; its application to exact Markov projected time reversibility has to be compared against general group-automorphism theory in independent priority review.
The inspected literature coverage is finite, and the theorem is not independently certified.

value.rationale: One-bit observation of multistate conformational cycles is a realistic information constraint. The theorem identifies the smallest homogeneous dissipation-bearing ring permitting any binary detection of the stationary time arrow, shows a complete no-go for all smaller sizes and supplies the minimally sampled unequal-lag witness with a calculable nonzero signal. It is a motivated sharp structural classification rather than a single arbitrary lookup constant; statistical power under noise is not established.
